welcome.title: Nau mai ki Wai Action
welcome.subtitle: He taputapu hei tiaki i ngā wai o Aotearoa.
welcome.body: Mā te whakamahi wai kia iti iho, mā te karo i ngā matū ki ngā rere, mā te whai wāhi ki ngā whakatau, ka pakari ake te hauora o te wai, o te tāngata.

why.title: Te take o tēnei app
why.body: Kei te pēhia ngā pūnaha wai o Aotearoa – he pūnaha tawhito, he taupori e tipu ana, he huringa āhuarangi, he iti ngā pūtea. Ka pā ēnei ki te haumaru o te wai inu, ki te wai paruparu, ki te wai ā-āwhina e rere ana ki ō tātou awa, moana.

bullets.rest: He taonga te wai; me whai wāhi mai ngā iwi, ngā hapū ki ngā whakatau.
Tiakina te mauri o te wai mō āpōpō.
Hāpai i te mana o te tangata; whakauru i ngā ahurea katoa.

actions.title: Ngā mahi wai
actions.intro: Kōwhiria tētahi mahi iti e toru: tētahi mō te whakamahi wai, tētahi mō ngā matū, tētahi mō te whai wāhi. Ka huihuia ēnei mahi iti e te hapori, ka nui te hua mō te wai, mō te tāngata.

modules.title: Whakamahia te wai kia iti iho
modules.subtitle: Ngā huarahi māmā hei whakaheke i tō whakamahi wai.
modules.body: Mā te whakaiti i te whakamahi wai ka māmā ake te pēhanga ki ngā pūnaha wai inu, wai paruparu hoki.

cards.rest: Whāia te 4 meneti, iti iho rānei.
I te wā o te horoi niho, te kanikani rānei.
He ōrite te ~13 L mō te kī me te haurua — ka kore utu ngā rihi tāpiri.
He rīki e rere ana? Whakatikatika wawe.

cards.lead: Upoko kaukau e whakaheke ana i te rere

modules.title: Kaua e tukuna ngā matū ki ngā wai
modules.subtitle: Ko te ua anake ki ngā rere.
modules.body: He nui ngā wā, kāore e tātaritia te wai ā-āwhina; ko ngā mea ka horoia ki ngā rori, ki ngā ngongo, ka tae tika ki ngā awa.

cards.rest: Kaua e tukuna ngā tae, hinu, matū ki ngā rere.

cards.lead: Horoia te waka ki runga pātītī
cards.rest: Kaua ki runga sima e rere ana.

cards.lead: Kaua e ringi hinu ki te ngongo
cards.rest: Tukuna kia mātao, kātahi ka maka.

modules.title: Whai wāhi ki ngā whakatau mō te wai
modules.subtitle: Tō reo, tō pānga.
modules.body: Ka taea e koe te whai pānga ki ngā whakatau a te kaunihera, a te hapori mō te wai – mā ngā whakaaro, mā ngā hui, mā ngā kaupapa tiaki awa.

cards.rest: Ki ngā Mahere Roa, ki ngā rautaki wai.
Mō te wai, mō ngā awa, mō ngā rere.
Tiaki awa, whakatipu rākau, whakatipu repo.

location.label: Tō tūwāhi
location.helper: Kia tika ai ngā mōhiohio mō tō rohe (kaunihera, awa, kaupapa).

notifications.title: Ngā panonitanga
options: Ngā hui me ngā wānanga a-rohe
Ngā mōhiohio haumaru wai inu (pēnei i ngā pānui whakapupū)

severityHelp.major: E pupū ana, e pīkari ana rānei; e rere ana puta noa i te rori, i te ara hīkoi rānei; e waipuke ana i te whenua; he rua, he tōngo rānei i te rori; kua ngaro te pēhanga wai.
severityHelp.minor: He rere iti; he pātītī mākū, poipoi rānei; he wai e tū ana; he mīta, he rīki rānei e tūheke ana.
